title: Installation Terms for a New Micro Market: Signature, Lead Time and Opening
content:
An Unattended Micro Market Program agreement is drawn up as a proposal, moves into installation on signature, and opens to employees once fixtures, coolers, kiosk and first stocking are in place. The installation charge and the equipment lease are those printed against the market format proposed, and the installation charge is invoiced when installation is scheduled rather than at opening.

## The lead time gate

The market may not open earlier than the installation lead time for the market format, counted in calendar days from the day the client signs the micro market agreement. Calendar days are counted from the day after signature, every day of the week counts, and the boundary day itself is a permitted opening day; calendar days are never converted into full 24-hour periods.

The day of signature is taken from the agreement's own start date as the company's records hold it, not from the client's account of when the paperwork went round. The comparison is not-earlier-than, and equality on the boundary day satisfies it.

| Reading | Judgement |
| --- | --- |
| Opening asked for on the boundary day itself | in time; the boundary day is a permitted opening day |
| Opening asked for on the day before the boundary day | earlier than the lead time allows |

## Standing of the agreement

An agreement is only worked on for installation while it stands proposed, installing or active, and a proposal withdrawn before signature closes with no installation charge falling due. The standing consulted is the one the company's records show for that agreement, before any installation work is taken up.

## Format and abandonment

Where the site's reported headcount or expected monthly sales do not meet the entry gate of the format proposed, the agreement is written for the highest format whose entry gate the site does meet. An installation abandoned after fixtures are ordered closes the agreement and carries the equipment removal charge printed against the format, and nothing more.
